Semester 7: Community, Research & Midwifery II

Read the summary line. If it feels unfamiliar, open the chapter and study the diagram.

Community Health Nursing II

National Health Programmes

  • Major national programmes for communicable and non-communicable disease — TB, HIV, malaria, leprosy, blindness, nutrition and NCD.
  • Describe national programmes for major diseases
  • Explain the nurse’s role in each programme

Nursing Research & Statistics

Research & the Research Process

  • Nursing research — meaning, purpose, the research process steps and the role of the nurse in research.
  • Define nursing research and its purposes
  • List the steps of the research process

Midwifery / OBG Nursing II

Recognition & Management of Abnormal Pregnancy

  • Abnormal pregnancy — bleeding in early and late pregnancy, hypertensive disorders, anaemia, diabetes, multiple pregnancy and malpresentation.
  • Recognise bleeding in early and late pregnancy
  • Diagnose and manage pre-eclampsia and eclampsia

Community Health Nursing II

Maternal & Child Health Services

  • Maternal and child health services — antenatal, intrapartum, postnatal care and child health services in the community.
  • Describe the components of MCH care
  • Explain antenatal and intrapartum care in the community

Nursing Research & Statistics

Research Problem, Objectives & Hypotheses

  • Formulating the research problem — sources, criteria, variables, objectives and hypotheses.
  • Select and state a research problem
  • Identify variables in a study

Midwifery / OBG Nursing II

Abnormal Labour & Obstetric Emergencies

  • Abnormal labour and obstetric emergencies — obstructed labour, malpresentation, cord prolapse, rupture, shock and post-partum haemorrhage.
  • Recognise obstructed labour
  • Manage cord prolapse and shoulder dystocia

Community Health Nursing II

Demography, Surveillance & Vital Statistics

  • Demography, surveillance and vital statistics — population data, censuses, rates and the nurse’s role in records.
  • Describe demography and vital statistics
  • Explain census and its uses

Nursing Research & Statistics

Review of Literature

  • Review of literature — purpose, sources, how to search, compile and write a literature review.
  • Describe the purpose of a review of literature
  • List primary and secondary sources

Midwifery / OBG Nursing II

Postnatal Complications

  • Postnatal complications — postpartum haemorrhage, infection, subinvolution, thromboembolism and postpartum psychiatric disorders.
  • Recognise postpartum haemorrhage and sepsis
  • Manage subinvolution and urinary problems

Community Health Nursing II

Population & Family Welfare

  • Population dynamics, family welfare programmes, national population policy and the nurse’s role.
  • Describe population trends in India
  • Explain the National Population Policy

Nursing Research & Statistics

Research Approaches & Designs

  • Research designs — experimental, quasi-experimental, descriptive, correlational, qualitative and their threats to validity.
  • Describe quantitative designs
  • Explain experimental and quasi-experimental designs

Midwifery / OBG Nursing II

High-Risk Newborn

  • High-risk newborn — birth asphyxia, low birth weight, jaundice, respiratory distress, sepsis and the neonatal unit.
  • Identify the high-risk newborn
  • Describe resuscitative care at birth

Community Health Nursing II

Occupational Health

  • Occupational health — pre-placement checks, hazards, compensation, ESI, occupational diseases and prevention.
  • Describe occupational health care
  • List workplace hazards

Nursing Research & Statistics

Sampling & Data Collection

  • Sampling and data collection — population, sample, techniques, tools, reliability, validity and ethics.
  • Differentiate population and sample
  • Describe probability and non-probability sampling

Midwifery / OBG Nursing II

Gynaecological Disorders & Operations

  • Gynaecological disorders — menstrual problems, infection, infertility, prolapse, cancers, menopause and post-operative nursing care.
  • Describe menstrual disorders and their care
  • Identify common gynaecological infections

Community Health Nursing II

Geriatric Health Care

  • Geriatric care — ageing, common problems, care of the elderly at home and in the community, and elder abuse.
  • Describe the ageing process
  • List common problems of old age

Nursing Research & Statistics

Analysis & Interpretation of Data

  • Analyzing and interpreting research data — editing, coding, descriptive and inferential statistics, tables and discussion.
  • Prepare data for analysis
  • Calculate descriptive statistics

Community Health Nursing II

Mental Health in the Community

  • Community mental health — programmes, DMHP, family burden, rehabilitation, stigma reduction and emergency care.
  • Describe community mental health programmes
  • Explain family burden and support

Nursing Research & Statistics

Introduction to Statistics

  • Statistics for nurses — scales of measurement, data presentation, central tendency, dispersion and normal distribution.
  • Describe scales of measurement
  • Present data using tables and graphs

Community Health Nursing II

Health Management Information System

  • HMIS and health information systems — records, registers, reports, digital health and the nurse’s record-keeping duties.
  • Describe HMIS and its components
  • List important records and registers

Nursing Research & Statistics

Communicating & Using Research

  • Communicating and using research — writing the report, presenting, referencing, and applying findings to practice.
  • Write a research report in the standard format
  • Present findings at conference and posters

Community Health Nursing II

Managing Community Health Services

  • Managing community health services — team building, work planning, supervision, logistics and reporting.
  • Describe the team in community health
  • Plan and supervise community programmes

Community Health Nursing II

School Health, Disaster & New Initiatives

  • School health programmes, disaster management and new initiatives in community health nursing.
  • Describe the school health programme
  • Explain disaster management
